observations: Photo 0: Open chest freezer lid interior, dome-shaped evaporator plate, some ice crystals visible on inner walls.
Photo 1: Front of unit with 'Haier THERMOCOOL' badge and a '2 Years Warranty' sticker; visible orange/brown rust spreading along the bottom front edge and corners.
Photo 2: Rear view showing condenser coils, a compressor housing, a rating/label plate (text too small/blurry to read model number), and a power plug; rust visible at the base corners.
No photo shows the unit powered on, a thermostat dial setting, a running compressor, or a temperature readout.
No photo of the receipt or warranty card mentioned by the seller.
Seller's new message is text only, no new photo or video provided.

claims.claim: Classic and reliable Thermocool freezer with long-lasting freezing capacity
claims.evidence: No photo or clip shows the unit running or holding temperature.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year
claims.evidence: No dated receipt or purchase proof shown in any photo; visible rust on the casing is inconsistent with a one-year-old unit but not conclusive.

claims.claim: No fault at all, motor was never opened
claims.evidence: Rear photo (photo 2) shows the compressor and coils intact but gives no proof of operation or that it has not been serviced.
Not shown in any of the 3 photos; only a printed warranty sticker is visible in photo 1.

claims.claim: 'I tested it myself yesterday, everything I said is true'
claims.evidence: Verbal assurance only, no new photo or video supplied to confirm.

risks.risk: Freezer may not actually cool/freeze despite claims
risks.proof: A short video of the unit plugged in, running, with thermostat light on and frost forming after some minutes

risks.risk: Visible rust at the base and corners could indicate age, moisture damage, or structural weakening beyond 'barely used' condition
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the rusted areas and the underside/base of the unit
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetically damaged, below 'barely used' tier

risks.risk: Compressor or sealed system condition unknown; rear coils could hide leaks or prior repairs
risks.proof: Clear photo/video of the compressor data plate and a cooling test

risks.risk: Door seal/gasket integrity not confirmed, which affects cooling efficiency
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the gasket seal all around the lid
risks.if_unproven: priced as having seal wear, worst case

risks.risk: Ownership documents (receipt, warranty card) unverified, affecting resale/warranty value
risks.proof: Clear photo of the receipt and warranty card with matching serial number

proof_requests: Video of the freezer plugged in and running, showing thermostat indicator light and frost build-up over a few minutes
Close-up photos of the rusted base/corners and underside of the unit
Clear photo of the rating/serial plate on the back (photo 2 area) for model verification
Photo of the receipt and warranty card with legible date and serial number
Close-up of the door gasket/seal condition
response.reason: A verbal reassurance with no new photo or video does not change the evidence; the freezer is identifiable but its working condition, true age, and documentation remain unverified, so it stays priced at worst case until proof is shown.
